column1: # Raw commands that a Skill Deck script owns (#506). raw_command_guard.py refuses each one before
# it runs and names the script instead.
# command  the words after `gh`, matched as a prefix of the command's own words.
# flags    `-`, or comma-separated globs; the row matches only when a later word matches one.
# script   the owning script, relative to the skills folder of the Skill Deck checkout.
# usage    the usage line the refusal prints.
# `pr reply` is no gh command: it is the row a `gh api` reply to a review comment is refused with.
# `issue edit --type` has no row: a type is a name from the repository's fixed list, no text an agent
# wrote, and these repositories carry the type as a `type:` label (#1289).
# Anything not listed passes, read-only commands such as `gh issue view` and `gh api` reads
# included. `git commit` is guarded by the commit-msg and pre-commit hooks instead; skipping them
# (`--no-verify`, `-n`, `-c core.hooksPath=`) needs no row: the guard refuses it (#685). A recursive
# `grep` needs no row: the guard refuses it and names `rg` (#686). A force push needs no row: the
# guard refuses it and points to the one allowed (#773).

publish.py pr --repo OWNER/NAME --edit N --expected-updated-at TS [--title TITLE] < body.md (#1211)

publish.py comment --repo OWNER/NAME --number N < body.md, then gh pr close N without --comment (#1211)
